title: 1996 Topps The X-Files Season 2 #63 Anasazi Trading Card
descriptionText: The VTG 1996 Topps The X-Files Season 2 Card #63 features the episode "Anasazi" from the popular TV show "The X-Files." This collectible trading card is part of the original set manufactured by Topps in 1996, made of card stock with a 20 Pt. thickness. The card showcases characters Mulder and Scully in a glossy insert set, perfect for fans of the franchise and collectors of non-sport trading cards. With its vintage appeal and focus on action and sci-fi genres, this card is a must-have for any X-Files enthusiast looking to add a piece of TV history to their collection.
